# EmitModelsOptions.decorators property

Whether the classes carry the  decorators. Defaults to `true`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
decorators?: boolean;
```

## Remarks

`false` emits plain classes and no import of `@imqueue/rpc`<!-- -->, for a service that is not an  service. See `Decorations`<!-- -->.
